# ui::JumpListHost

Header: `winui/ui/JumpList.hpp`.

What keeps the app's jump list for [ui::set_jump_list()](namespace-ui.md#set_jump_list) and [ui::add_recent_file()](namespace-ui.md#add_recent_file).

There is one for the whole process: the platform's, or a double a test installs with [`ui::testing::set_jump_list_host()`](../testing/namespace-ui-testing.md#set_jump_list_host). App code calls the two free functions and never needs the class. It is public so a test double can derive from it.

## ~JumpListHost

```cpp
virtual ~JumpListHost() = default
```

## set_tasks

```cpp
virtual void set_tasks(std::vector<JumpTask> tasks) = 0
```

Replaces the Tasks section with `tasks`.

## add_recent_file

```cpp
virtual void add_recent_file(const std::filesystem::path& path) = 0
```

Adds `path` to the recent files.
